title: SS-6436 Sabre NDC - Sabre OAuth token is never renewed after a 401 (dead retry branch, cached token never invalidated)

summary: Exact user-supplied Search returned HTTP 200 with 37 matching V/8KI0 offers. Result returned HTTP 200, preserving the selected opaque key and V/8KI0 identifiers, with populated itinerary segments and totalPrice=595.

Earlier different-input attempts are retained separately and excluded from this verdict. Several inputs changed together, so the cause of earlier empty responses is not isolated. OAuth recovery is outside regression scope. No booking, ticketing or configuration changes. No lessons applied; ledger unchanged.
